_comment: Pemberton is in neither city Oria Haven covers. It is 3.5 hours from
Perth and 1.5 hours from Margaret River town, roughly 104km away as
the crow flies, and it sits in the Southern Forests rather than the
Capes. Filed here under the Margaret River city with Pemberton as its
own area, which makes the profile read '104 km from Margaret River'.
That is true, and it is also the profile telling the reader it is not
really there. The alternative is a third city for one listing, which
is the thin hub the indexing floors exist to prevent.
The 'pemberton' area term does not exist yet. Create it under the
Margaret River city before importing, or the importer will warn and
leave the listing without an area.
Every fact below comes from floatingsauna.com.au and its own Acuity
booking page, checked 17 September 2026. Nothing here claims a sauna
treats anything; their own FAQ tells people with a medical condition
to ask their practitioner first, and that is their line to draw.

listings.name: Floating Sauna Pemberton
listings.excerpt: Two wood-fired saunas floating on Pemberton Pool, each with a floor-to-ceiling window onto the water and the karri forest behind it. The third location of a Tasmanian original and the only one in Western Australia, it opened in August 2026, three and a half hours south of Perth and an hour and a half from Margaret River. Sessions run hourly from 7am to 9pm, seven days: $55 a person to share a sauna with up to five others, or $305 to have one of the two rooms to yourself with a sauna master on hand. It is off-grid, so bring your own towel and water, and the nearest toilet is a ten-minute walk.
services: Shared wood-fired sauna session (1 hour, from $55 per person)
Private sauna hire (1 hour, $305 for up to six)
